summary.text: Kate Hogan is a Democratic state representative from Stow who has represented the 3rd Middlesex District since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has been named Speaker Pro Tempore and spent more than 25 years in the publishing and print industry before her first election.

paragraphs.text: Hogan graduated from St. Mary's High School and holds a B.A. from the University of Massachusetts Amherst, where she is involved in the Women into Leadership program.
Before her first election in 2008 she spent more than 25 years working in the publishing and print industry.

Ballotpedia lists her professional experience as including Vice President of Gnomon, Inc., executive director of SFI, operations and sales manager for Sojourner: The Women's Forum, and media and print sales executive with Kennedy Publishing.
Hogan is in her seventh term as state representative for the 3rd Middlesex District and was recently named Speaker Pro Tempore, a member of the Speaker's leadership team.
In past terms she served as House Division Leader and as House chair of the Joint Committee on Public Health.
She serves on the House Committees on Ethics, on Operations, Facilities and Security, and on Rules, the Joint Committee on Rules, and the Special Joint Committee on Initiative Petitions.
She has served as co-chair of the Maynard Democratic Town Committee and as a board member of the Stow Community Preservation Committee.
